item.title: Leading haematologist Professor John Seymour AM joins Leukaemia Foundation board
item.description: The Leukaemia Foundation is delighted to announce the appointment of Professor John Seymour to its Board, effective immediately.

item.title: Leukaemia Foundation welcomes Professor James Ward to its board
item.description: The Leukaemia Foundation is pleased to announce the appointment of Professor James Ward to its Board, effective immediately.

item.title: Blood cancer… the single biggest tragedy impacting Aussie kids and forcing them out of classrooms
item.description: As kids around Australia return to classrooms this week, hundreds will not – their desks sit empty as they fight the single biggest disease threatening the lives of school-aged children in Australia today – blood cancer

item.title: Margot’s gift: A lasting act of love for generations to come
item.description: For 92-year-old Margot Davies, the decision to leave a gift to the Leukaemia Foundation was a deeply personal one. It was shaped by love, loss, and a belief that no one facing blood cancer should ever feel alone.

item.title: Meet the Melbourne barber shaving the world from blood cancer
item.description: The Leukaemia Foundation’s iconic World’s Greatest Shave campaign returns in 2026, encouraging participants around the country to shave, cut or colour their hair in solidarity to raise critical funds and awareness for the 170,000 Australians facing blood cancer.

item.title: ‘Put as much as I can back into the system’: Ian Brandon shares why he’s turning gratitude into action
item.description: Cheryl Brandon was diagnosed with non-Hodgkin lymphoma – starting a decade-long blood cancer journey. Her husband Ian discusses the care and support he and Cheryl received, how he continues to honour Cheryl and her legacy, and the importance of giving back.

item.title: International Childhood Cancer Day highlights blood cancer as the biggest cancer threat to Australian children
item.description: Blood cancer is the most commonly diagnosed childhood cancer in Australia – and its growing impact is robbing far too many young Australians of the normal childhood they deserve.

item.title: ‘Made me the person I am today’: Siobhan Hoy reflects on the positives of her blood cancer journey and the power of laughter and support.
item.description: Explore the emotional toll of illness through Siobhan Hoy's journey with blood cancer from her teenage years to adulthood.

item.title: From patient to advocate: How blood cancer patient Kathy now helps guide the Leukaemia Foundation’s work
item.description: Kathy is a proud mother and grandmother of three from Newcastle, NSW who has had her life turned upside down by blood cancer three times.

item.title: The Block’s Robby and Mat join the World’s Greatest Shave following co-star’s tragic loss
item.description: The Block’s fan favourites – Robby and Mat – are swapping tools for trimmers for the World's Greatest Shave in a powerful show of solidarity with their close friend, builder Dave Reidy, following the heartbreaking loss of his wife Carly to blood cancer.
